notes:
Summary: Mid-market product-analytics SaaS (EU HQ) building a customer-facing support assistant + semantic search. Started on Hosted API POC but moving to evaluate Dedicated for data residency and predictable throughput.

POC highlights: hosted API worked ease-of-use wise; engineering could integrate SDK in <48h. Observed latency variance when requests routed out of EU (third-party model variants live in US edge for capacity). p95 around 120ms during local tests but spiked to ~180ms for long-context support queries. Embeddings batch throughput target ~100-200 qps for nightly indexing.

Customer requirements / asks: 
- "can't have customer PII leave EU" (CPO quote from discovery) — absolute: data residency EU & audit trail.
- Need SSO + SCIM for admin provisioning.
- Audit logs + KMS integration for key control.
- Prefer open/Redwood-verified models; willing to consider quantized variants if quality holds.

Routing & architecture notes: 
- Primary: EU region (Dublin). Failover: US for burst only; ask about automatic routing policies and regional affinity.
- Concern about multi-region tradeoff: lower cost/availability vs increased token egress and higher latency for some requests. Wants proposal that minimizes cross-region calls (prefix/KV caching, regional caches).

Commercial: 
- Interested in Hosted API short-term (POC) then Dedicated reserved capacity for production if can meet residency SLAs.
- Price sensitivity: mid-market predictable monthly commit; asked for 12-month reserved pricing examples.

Open items / Blockers: 
- Legal needs DPA + data flow diagram (requested).
- Pricing: need dedicated reserved capacity worksheet (AE to send).
- Technical: quantify expected latency with EU-only model variants vs multi-region fallback. SE action: provide latency profile matrix + caching recommendations.

Next steps already agreed: Dedicated demo w/ pricing on 2026-03-16; SE to deliver EU architecture doc and sample DPA redline by 2026-03-13. Procurement expects decision by 2026-04.
